Question:
Please help me identify the top 3 bowlers who, in the overs where the maximum runs were conceded in each match, gave up the highest number of runs in a single over across all matches. For each of these bowlers, provide the match in which they conceded these maximum runs. Only consider overs that had the most runs conceded within their respective matches, and among these, determine which bowlers conceded the most runs in a single over overall.

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
WITH runs_per_over AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id,
        b.over_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.over_id
),
max_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(total_runs) as max_runs
    FROM runs_per_over
    GROUP BY match_id
),
max_runs_overs AS (
    SELECT ro.match_id, ro.over_id, ro.total_runs
    FROM runs_per_over ro
    JOIN max_runs_per_match mrm ON ro.match_id = mrm.match_id AND ro.total_runs = mrm.max_runs
),

),
